text:
ashley: quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands re: regional GPU supply, autoscale fallbacks, and route priorities. keeping it tight.
tom: thanks. can we get specifics on which hardware will land in APAC pilot? folks keep asking T4 vs A10g vs A2.
ashley: APAC pilot will include T4 burst pockets and A10g for reserved Dedicated in selected zones. we may add A2 where latency-critical low-cost paths are needed. full zone list next week.
mina: autoscaler pool priority? product wants to tag routes with expected latency windows.
ashley: priority = reserved (committed) -> prewarm (warm pool) -> burst (spot/partner) -> model fallback. teams can opt routes into "region-affinity" to avoid cross-region overflow.
sree: two asks from infra: product teams should add route tags: `latency: p95<250ms`, `region_affinity: eu`, `critical:true`. will make prewarm decisions deterministic.
tom: eviction behavior when spot/burst is reclaimed? do we retry or degrade?
ashley: eviction flow: quick attempt to pull from prewarm (200ms), then transparently switch to a quantized fallback (we're standardizing on `q2.7b` family for large models and `q1.3b` for medium). only after queued retries (max 250ms) do we return 503.
mina: formula for prewarm sizing we can share with finance/cloud procurement?
sree: suggested formula (conservative): `prewarm_slots = ceil(route_qps * p95_latency_s * 1.8)`. example: qps=15, p95=0.3s -> 15*0.3*1.8=8.1 -> 9 slots. recommend floor min 10 for production-critical.
ashley: billing note: Hosted PAYG will show prewarm as a separate line; Dedicated customers get prewarm in commit. we'll add a per-route `prewarm_opt_out` flag.
tom: can we see prewarm and eviction metrics in Console soon?
ashley: yes  Console beta will include prewarm utilization, eviction_count, and cross-region overflow metrics. ETA: ~2 weeks.
sree: action: infra to publish a 1-page "GPU pressure & routing playbook" by Thursday. owner: sree. will include paging matrix, alert thresholds (e.g., sustained GPU util >85% for 5m), and quick mitigations.
mina: canary windows update after last week's incidents?
ashley: new canary: 30m light-traffic check + 90m scale-observation with synthetic load ramp at +20% to validate autoscaler. ops will run synthetic at minute 10.
ops-bot: notes + deck -> https://redwood.company/all-hands/2026-03-20 (deck v10.3). :spiral_notepad:
ashley: scheduling a 30m follow-up sync Tue 10am PT to collect tagged routes and expected QPS. invite from sree. DM me any special cases. :thumbsup:
